silicon.Description: Whether the contact is recorded as silicon-based in the source deposit (yes/no), copied unchanged from on004080.

soz.Description: Seizure-onset-zone indicator as deposited in on004080 (yes/no).

resected.Description: Whether the tissue at the contact was resected, as deposited in on004080 (yes/no).

edge.Description: Whether the contact lies at the edge of the grid or strip, as deposited in on004080 (yes/no).

Destrieux_label.Description: Numeric Destrieux atlas label code for the contact location, as deposited in on004080.

Destrieux_label_text.Description: Text name of the Destrieux atlas region for the contact location, as deposited in on004080.
